quality_check.description: A single vertical first-frame illustration centers the recurring glass orb inside a damp rooftop greenhouse. The orb preserves the spherical glass body, aged-bronze equatorial band, three-claw cradle, crescent brace and moss-green cord knot. Two long-fingered crone hands and moss-green sleeves physically hold and touch it, while a black raven watches from the left. Inside the orb is an abandoned urban glimpse with empty streets, stalled cars, dark towers, encroaching vegetation, roaming deer and a flooded or descending transit entrance. The surrounding greenhouse includes weathered glass, tomato trellises, wet concrete and distant high-rises, all presented with a distressed charcoal-and-graphite illustration feel and weathered paper frame.
violations: The requested unattended irrigation sequence is not clearly staged; the greenhouse is visibly wet and streaked, but active ceiling-nozzle mist sweeping the vegetable rows is not strongly legible.
The requested narrow side-eye from the crone is absent because her face is kept out of frame, although ownership remains unmistakable through her hands, sleeves and direct handling of the orb.

The greenhouse and character-adjacent rendering is somewhat cleaner and more ink-illustrative than the style reference's strongest rough charcoal abrasion, soot bloom and rubbed graphite haze, though the overall palette, distressed texture and frame language remain substantially continuous.
A tiny sign-like marking appears on the transit entrance inside the orb and risks reading as lettering, contrary to the no-readable-text direction.

prompt:
Create one 9:16 first frame centered on the recurring magic orb from the attached identity sheet.
Preserve its sphere, aged-bronze equatorial band, three-claw cradle, crescent brace and moss-green cord
knot. Make ownership and agency unmistakably the old crone's using the attached character identity:
show one strong cue such as her long fingers touching the cradle, a moss-green sleeve framing it, her
hunched shadow/reflection, or her black raven beside it; do not require a full face or body. Inside the
orb, stage a still subject-specific glimpse directed by the episode brief, gradually adopting the
attached world style's palette, texture, atmosphere and frame language. The world style affects the
orb interior and surrounding presentation, never the crone's identity or the orb's locked geometry.
No readable text, generic crystal ball, unrelated wizard, UI, 3D CGI or photorealism.

EPISODE TOPIC: What If Every Human Vanished Tomorrow??
EPISODE DIRECTION: Early-morning rooftop greenhouse, weathered glass panes, damp concrete, sagging tomato trellises, irrigation tubing, silent high-rises beyond. Fine mist already sweeps unattended vegetable rows as ceiling nozzles activate in sequence. The crone pauses mid-knot, narrow side-eye tracking the spray; raven watches. Her moss-green sleeve enters foreground, long fingers wiping one water bead before deliberately revealing and raising her orb toward camera, clearly establishing ownership. Within its glass: empty streets, dark towers, encroaching vines, roaming animals, flooded infrastructure.
